title: Screen-reader traversal announces the step heading and body on open
iWant: the tooltip to announce the step heading and body on open through the ARIA APG dialog-modal contract
soThat: I hear the step content the moment focus arrives, not after a manual navigation

acceptanceCriteria.description: The tooltip carries aria-labelledby pointing at the step heading and aria-describedby pointing at the step body; focus moves into the tooltip on open so the screen reader reads the labelled and described text. Documented as a mechanism-reach gap for the described-text read order because rcf-lite does not drive a real screen reader in CI; the pack asserts the DOM contract and the fixture README names the manual screen-reader smoke.

On close of the tour (Escape, dismiss or last-step confirm), a polite live region announces the outcome (completed or dismissed) so screen-reader users know the state transition happened without inspecting the surface.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a tour step is open and the principal closes the tour
acceptanceCriteria.then: a polite live region announces "onboarding tour completed" or "onboarding tour dismissed"
